local.h: FBI probes firebomb at Atlanta ICE office
local.b: The FBI is investigating a Molotov cocktail-style device thrown at the downtown ICE Atlanta Field Office Tuesday night. It caused minor damage.
local.title: FBI investigates reported attack on Atlanta ICE office, offers $20K reward

local.h: Ballot measure would create fund for 911 upgrades
local.b: A proposed constitutional amendment would create a dedicated fund lawmakers could use to modernize Georgia's 911 system, though it would not allocate any money itself.
local.title: Ballot amendment would pave the way for dedicated funding to upgrade Georgia’s 911 system

local.h: Georgia tackles rural maternal health crisis
local.b: With labor and delivery units closing in rural Georgia, some expectant mothers face long drives to give birth.
local.title: Georgia gears up to solve rural maternal health crisis

local.h: Johnson revives corporate head tax in budget
local.b: Mayor Brandon Johnson's $17.6 billion budget resurrects his failed corporate head tax and proposes another increase in the cloud computing tax.
local.title: Mayor Johnson renews fight for his failed corporate head tax

local.h: Second woman says she was drugged at UChicago frat
local.b: A woman told police she feared she was drugged before a sexual assault at a University of Chicago fraternity house in February. She has sued Alpha Delta Phi.

local.h: Gary residents still plagued by blackouts
local.b: Months after an August storm, Gary residents report frequent power outages whenever it rains or gets windy.
local.title: Months after storm, Gary residents are plagued with blackouts

local.h: Stratton, Tracy clash in only Senate debate
local.b: Democrat Juliana Stratton and Republican Don Tracy split on the minimum wage, immigration and tariffs in their only debate for Dick Durbin's Senate seat.

local.h: Johnson budget would reopen mental health clinic
local.b: Mayor Brandon Johnson's 2027 budget would reopen a city mental health clinic and spend $5 million to make the CARE crisis response program permanent.

local.h: Fearing ICE, some immigrants shift life to night
local.b: Some Chicago immigrants now wait until nighttime to do laundry, shop and work to avoid immigration enforcement.

local.h: What a stressed grid means for Illinois customers
local.b: WBEZ's Curious City looks at the strain on Illinois' electric grid and what it could mean for consumers.

local.h: Parents charged after teen dies in e-moto crash
local.b: The father of a 13-year-old who died driving an e-motorcycle at more than 40 mph faces a felony child endangerment charge, Orange County prosecutors said.
local.title: OC parents of teen who died in e-motorcycle crash face child endangerment charges

local.h: Eaton Fire homeowners can get free soil cleanup
local.b: A county pilot program will test and clean up potentially contaminated soil for eligible Altadena and unincorporated Pasadena homeowners.
local.title: Eaton Fire homeowners can now apply for free soil testing and cleanup. Here's how.

local.h: Long Beach plans sandbag giveaways for El Niño
local.b: Drive-through sandbag giveaways will be held at Long Beach City College on Oct. 24 and Nov. 7 ahead of an expected strong El Niño season.
local.title: Drive-through sandbag giveaways planned in Long Beach ahead of looming El Niño storms

local.h: Experts: don't panic over DOJ voter fraud suit
local.b: Election experts told LAist the federal lawsuit seeking to remove alleged noncitizens from California's rolls is unlikely to succeed and voters should fill out ballots as normal.
local.title: Feds are suing California over voter fraud allegations. Experts tell voters: Don’t freak out

local.h: Officer to face trial in Delrawn Small killing
local.b: NYPD Officer Wayne Isaacs, who shot and killed Delrawn Small in a 2016 Brooklyn traffic dispute, will face a departmental trial in January, the family said.
local.title: NYPD officer faces disciplinary trial 10 years after killing Delrawn Small

local.h: Port Authority plans $117M fix for GWB approach
local.b: The Port Authority plans to rehab a Manhattan approach to the George Washington Bridge where large debris fell from the ceiling onto cars.
local.title: Port Authority eyes $117M fix to Manhattan roadway where falling debris smashed cars

local.h: Bronx couple indicted in starvation of toddler
local.b: A Bronx couple is charged with starving their 3-year-old daughter to death and severely malnourishing her brother, prosecutors said.
local.title: Bronx couple starved their 3-year-old to death, indictment says

local.h: Marble Hill protester charged with assaulting agent
local.b: Federal prosecutors accuse Liberty Martin, 42, of assaulting a Homeland Security agent at a protest after an ICE shooting in Marble Hill.
local.title: Marble Hill protester accused of attacking federal agent faces assault charge

local.h: Brad Lander freed after West Bank detention
local.b: Brad Lander, Democratic nominee for NY-10, said Israeli forces detained him while he helped Palestinian farmers pick olives, then released him Wednesday morning.
local.title: Brad Lander says he's released after Israeli forces detained him during olive harvest

local.h: 3,000 families get childcare vouchers off waitlist
local.b: The Mamdani administration is notifying 3,000 families that they can get subsidized childcare vouchers. Nearly 30,000 are on the waitlist.
local.title: NYC’s subsidized childcare waitlist is moving, starting with 3K families

local.h: Musk spends $500K to re-elect Rep. Mike Lawler
local.b: Elon Musk has spent more than $500,000 backing Lawler in his competitive Hudson Valley race against Democrat Cait Conley.
local.title: Elon Musk drops $500K on NY Rep. Mike Lawler's re-election bid

local.h: Schools chancellor offers no integration plan
local.b: Chancellor Kamar Samuels said the Mamdani administration is committed to integrating NYC public schools but declined to share a specific plan, drawing groans from a frustrated crowd.
local.title: Parents grumble as NYC schools chancellor dodges calls for NYC schools integration plan

local.h: Retired NYPD detective charged in GWB shooting
local.b: A retired NYPD detective was arrested and charged with murder in the fatal shooting of a Rockland County man on the George Washington Bridge, police said.
local.title: Retired NYPD detective charged with murder in George Washington Bridge shooting

local.h: Protests banned in parts of Paris Thursday
local.b: Rallies are banned from 8am to 8pm near the Elysée, parliament, the Louvre, the Champs-Elysées, Bastille, République and Châtelet-Les Halles.
local.title: Protests banned in parts of Paris on Thursday

local.h: Two killed in French fighter jet crash
local.b: A Mirage 2000D crashed during a training flight near its air base outside Nancy, killing its 27-year-old pilot and 44-year-old navigator.
local.title: French fighter jet crashes during training leaves two killed

local.h: French government websites down after hacking alert
local.b: Tax and préfecture websites went down and Météo France took its sites offline after a critical vulnerability was found in the PHP programming language.
local.title: French government websites down after hacking alert

local.h: Orange hit by nationwide phone and internet outage
local.b: Orange said a nationwide incident was severely disrupting calls, texts and mobile internet, with thousands of reports logged by midday.

local.h: Wilson expands World Cup homeless plan citywide
local.b: Mayor Katie Wilson said a program that moved Pioneer Square homeless residents into housing before the World Cup will expand across Seattle at no extra cost.
local.title: Seattle Mayor Wilson wants to expand World Cup homeless plan to entire city

local.h: Amazon worker sues over assault complaint
local.b: A Seattle-based Amazon employee says the company failed to protect her after she reported being raped by a senior manager, and made her keep working with him.
local.title: Amazon sued for failing to protect employee who accused a manager of sexual assault

local.h: Bite of Seattle shooting suspect, 15, released
local.b: A judge released the 15-year-old to his family, saying no recovered evidence ties him to the deaths or injuries at the July festival.

local.h: Council restricts overnight RV parking
local.b: The Seattle City Council passed a package limiting RVs to two hours of street parking starting next year and aiming to steer vehicle residents into shelter and services.
